description.en: Open the Explorer at Monotremata to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开单孔类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 其他哺乳动物出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Other mammals time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的其他哺乳动物时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 其他哺乳动物证据比较

description.en: Compare eritherium and mimolagus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较eritherium与mimolagus；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: At 105 Ma, inspect the Griman Creek Formation context for the tooth-bearing right dentary AM F66763. The linked primary description supports the specimen and published dental comparison, while monotreme affinity remains an interpretation.
description.zh: 在 1.05 亿年前的地图上检查格里曼溪组中带齿右下颌 AM F66763 的地层背景。关联的一手描述直接支持该标本及已发表的牙齿比较，而其单孔类亲缘仍属于解释。

limitations: The 110–100 Ma window is the broad formation context of one named specimen; it is not a global monotreme first appearance, a crown-membership result, a direct ancestor claim or an exact fossil-to-map co-registration.

title.zh: 侏罗兽有条件的侏罗纪背景

description.en: At 160 Ma, examine the originally attributed Tiaojishan context of partial skeleton BMNH PM1343B together with its explicit provenance and tip-dating dispute. The map preserves the published attribution without converting it into a secure calibration.
description.zh: 在 1.60 亿年前的地图上检查部分骨架 BMNH PM1343B 最初归属的髫髻山组背景，并同时保留其产地来源与尖端定年争议。地图保存已发表的归属，但不把它转化为可靠的校准点。

limitations: The routed interval follows the original stratigraphic attribution; collection provenance, morphology coding and tip-dating priors leave the age and topology contested, and the card does not establish a universal therian divergence date.

description.en: At 125 Ma, inspect the Yixian Formation context of articulated skeleton CAGS 01-IG-1a,b. Preserved dentition, feet and claws are direct evidence; eutherian placement and scansoriality remain matrix- and comparison-dependent.
description.zh: 在 1.25 亿年前的地图上检查义县组关节相连骨架 CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 的背景。保存的牙列、足部和爪是直接证据；真兽类位置与攀援生活方式仍取决于矩阵和功能比较。

limitations: This is the bounded context of one articulated specimen; later combined matrices can recover another placement, locomotion is inferred rather than observed, and no direct ancestry or exact map co-registration is implied.

description.en: At 60 Ma, inspect the early Thanetian lower bone bed of Sidi Chennane associated with holotype skull MNHN PM69 and the 15-specimen Eritherium hypodigm. Cranial and dental characters support a stem-proboscidean interpretation.
description.zh: 在 6000 万年前的地图上检查西迪谢纳讷早赞尼特期下部骨层，以及与之关联的正模头骨 MNHN PM69 和 15 件始祖象标本组合。颅骨与牙齿特征支持长鼻类干群解释。

limitations: The card is limited to the named hypodigm and early Thanetian locality interval; stem placement and body mass are comparative estimates, not a global proboscidean origin, complete range or direct-ancestor claim.

description.en: At 5.5 Ma, inspect the Pisco Formation context for five stratigraphically successive Thalassocnus species used in CT and thin-section comparisons. Increasing bone compactness supports a progressive aquatic-adaptation interpretation.
description.zh: 在 550 万年前的地图上检查皮斯科组中五个地层上连续的海懒兽物种，它们用于 CT 与薄片比较。骨骼致密度增加支持逐步水生适应的解释。

limitations: The 8–3 Ma window summarizes sampled Pisco Formation horizons; sample gaps and phylogenetic ordering bound the trend, while hydrostatic control, marine grazing and behaviour remain functional inferences.

description.en: At 51.4 Ma, inspect the Fossil Butte Member context of nearly complete holotype ROM 55351A. Wing proportions and cochlear anatomy provide morphological proxies for powered flight and limited laryngeal-echolocation specialization.
description.zh: 在 5140 万年前的地图上检查化石孤丘段中近完整正模 ROM 55351A 的背景。翼部比例与耳蜗解剖为动力飞行及有限喉源回声定位专化提供形态代理证据。

limitations: This is one holotype and one bounded formation interval; flight performance, echolocation capacity and stem placement are proxy- and matrix-based, and the specimen is not presented as a direct ancestor or a complete bat distribution.
